scope: Observable unloaded, shortened, supported and released final state plus adversarial integrity checks.
findings: Score measures spring compression≤0.5mm, shortening≤6mm, both wall gaps≥4.5mm, root within2mm of cradles and2s still/released with robot clearance≥20mm. It does not require expert phases or retain an irrelevant unloaded handle angle.

Tests reject wrong initial final-state substitution, body/frame tampering, broken joints, loss, penetration and rack/pinion skipping. The enclosure constrains direct pawl access; every intact alternative achieving the same physical goal remains legitimate.

Joint compliance/pose/gap measurements are specified with calipers, dial indicators, imagery and force gauges for reproduction. Complete22,794-value provenance identifies authored/derived values. No invented hardware measurement or manufacturer force/torque is used.

Native protocol now checks10s continuous hold displacement/integrity; CPU probes also check physics-substep peak contact depth. Diagnostic velocities use the ordinary link datum verified against the actual Jacobian.
decision: Objective numeric state scoring and integrity rules pass feasible offline adversarial checks; no ideal-tracking result is promoted to physical success.
